subtitle: Cross-check of 29/Sep/2026: Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, the four national polls released on 29/Sep, AtlasIntel BR-04391/2026, Palver BR-02990/2026, Gerp BR-03929/2026 and Vox Brasil BR-00895/2026, the two from 28/Sep, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) BR-06520/2026 and BTG/Nexus BR-07557/2026, and the press flow of 28 and 29/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 40.50% (vol USD 12.59M cumulative) in the winner contract, down 1.00pp raw and 1.11pp normalized, confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 1.00pp, to 23.55% (vol USD 1.09M). POLL: 45.3% to 42.2% in the first round and 47.6% to 47.7% in the second in AtlasIntel of 29/Sep; he leads the first round in four of the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep and the second in one.
fortes: Leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep: 39% to 34% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), 42% to 37% in BTG/Nexus, 45.3% to 42.2% in AtlasIntel and 41.1% to 37.8% in Vox Brasil.
In AtlasIntel of 29/Sep his [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) lead widens from 2.4 to 3.1 points against the 23/Sep round, with a margin of 1pp.

In Vox Brasil of 29/Sep he wins the three second-round pairings other than the one with Flávio Bolsonaro: 45.3% to 41.1% against Ronaldo Caiado, 44.8% to 35.1% against Augusto Cury and 46.1% to 30.3% against Romeu Zema.

In BTG/Nexus of 28/Sep he leads the five second-round pairings the pollster tested: 46% to 44% against Flávio Bolsonaro, 46% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 46% to 41% against Augusto Cury, 48% to 39% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 37% against Renan Santos.
fracos: Falls 1.00pp in the winner contract, to 40.50%, and the gap widens from 16.55pp to 18.80pp, the fourth straight widening between confirmed readings. Normalized by the pair's sum, which rose from 99.55 to 99.80, the loss is 1.11pp.
In the series recorded since April 14 his price is 27.00pp from the high, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 6.00pp from the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr.
Trails in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep, with the widest distance in Gerp, 43% to 50%, the only one outside the poll's own margin.
In the national polls of 29/Sep his approval falls below the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) benchmark: 45.2% against 53.6% disapproval in AtlasIntel and 44% against 51% in Gerp.
📺 Folha de S.Paulo, Valor and CBN report that allies believe he should skip the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, with no decision announced.
candidates.analise: Lula fell 1.00pp in the winner contract, to 40.50% (vol USD 12.59M cumulative), at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, and 1.11pp normalized, because the pair's sum rose from 99.55 to 99.80; with that the gap widens from 16.55pp to 18.80pp, the fourth straight widening between confirmed readings. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 1.00pp, to 23.55%. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep he leads the first round in four, ties in Palver and trails in Gerp, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads only in BTG/Nexus, ties in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and trails in the other four, three of them within the margin. AtlasIntel, which is the chart's benchmark, puts him 3.1 points ahead in the first round and 0.1 behind in the second. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 59.30% (vol USD 12.26M cumulative) in the winner contract, up 1.25pp raw and 1.11pp normalized, confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 2.00pp, to 76.50% (vol USD 1.27M). POLL: 42.2% in the first round and 47.7% in the second in AtlasIntel of 29/Sep; he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep.
fortes: Rises 1.25pp in the winner contract, to 59.30%, and the gap widens from 16.55pp to 18.80pp, the fourth straight widening between confirmed readings.
His price is 2.40pp from the series high, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.

Leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep: 50% to 43% in Gerp, 47% to 45% in Palver, 45.2% to 44.7% in Vox Brasil and 47.7% to 47.6% in AtlasIntel.
In Gerp of 29/Sep he also leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), by 42% to 40%, and in Palver he ties at 44%.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names favours him: 81% of Romeu Zema's voters, 48% of Renan Santos's, 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's and 34% of Augusto Cury's would go to him (O Globo).
fracos: Trails in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep, with the widest distance in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and BTG/Nexus, 5 points in each.
Of his four second-round leads on 28 and 29/Sep, three fall within the poll's own margin; only Gerp's, of 7 points, falls outside it.

⚖️ On the night of 28/Sep Luiz Fux, of the Supreme Court, suspended Flávio Dino's decision that had released the posts about Our Lady of Aparecida and reinstated, pending full-court review, André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) to take them down (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). The decision was requested by his campaign and stands until the full Supreme Court reviews the case.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.25pp in the winner contract, to 59.30% (vol USD 12.26M cumulative), at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, and 1.11pp normalized. With that the gap widens from 16.55pp to 18.80pp, the fourth straight widening between confirmed readings, and his price is 2.40pp from the series high, 61.70% on 21/Sep. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 2.00pp, to 76.50%. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 28 and 29/Sep he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four and the first round in one, Gerp; the four national polls released on 29/Sep, AtlasIntel (BR-04391/2026, n=5,005), Palver (BR-02990/2026, n=5,000), Gerp (BR-03929/2026, n=2,400) and Vox Brasil (BR-00895/2026, n=2,100), measure him from 37.8% to 44% in the first round and from 45.2% to 50% in the second. ⚖️ On the night of 28/Sep Luiz Fux, of the Supreme Court, suspended Flávio Dino's decision that had released the posts about Our Lady of Aparecida and reinstated, pending full-court review, André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) to take them down (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract (vol USD 5.17M cumulative) and 35.80% (vol USD 0.30M cumulative) in the third-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), down 9.30pp raw and 8.58pp normalized by the book's sum, at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT. POLL: 2.0% in AtlasIntel of 29/Sep and 5% in Gerp of the same day.
fortes: He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in Gerp of 29/Sep, with 5%, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos, with 3% each.
📺 He is one of the four invited to the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, from which Renan Santos was left out under the legal criterion of congressional representation (Folha de S.Paulo).
fracos: 🔴 Loses the lead of the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) to Renan Santos: falls 9.30pp raw and 8.58pp normalized, to 35.80%, and is 15.70pp behind, after being 2.10pp ahead at the confirmed reading of 28/Sep.
Has 2.0% in AtlasIntel and 1% in Palver of 29/Sep, behind Renan Santos in both.
Loses to Lula by 44.8% to 35.1% in the Vox Brasil second-round pairing of 29/Sep.
In the winner contract he remains at the floor of the book, 0.05%, and is priced below what his cumulative volume would suggest, USD 5.02M.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury fell 9.30pp raw in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), to 35.80% (vol USD 0.30M cumulative), at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, and 8.58pp normalized, because the book's sum fell from 103.10 to 101.80, and he lost the lead of that book to Renan Santos, who ended 15.70pp ahead. In the series of confirmed readings the distance was 4.15pp with Renan Santos ahead on 26/Sep, 2.90pp and 2.10pp with Augusto Cury ahead on 27 and 28/Sep, and now 15.70pp with Renan Santos ahead. 🗳️ In the national polls of 29/Sep he ranges from 1% in Palver to 5% in Gerp, where he is third. 📺 He is one of the four invited to the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.25% (vol USD 14.68M cumulative) in the winner contract and 51.50% (vol USD 0.46M cumulative) in the third-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), up 8.50pp raw and 8.88pp normalized by the book's sum, at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT. POLL: 5.2% in AtlasIntel and 8% in Palver of 29/Sep, third in both.
fortes: ⭐ Back in front in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): rises 8.50pp raw and 8.88pp normalized, to 51.50%, and is 15.70pp ahead of Augusto Cury, after being 2.10pp behind at the confirmed reading of 28/Sep.

He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in AtlasIntel of 29/Sep, with 5.2%, more than Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema combined, and in Palver of the same day, with 8%.

🏆 His contract in the winner book remains the one with the HIGHEST cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.68M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's, and in the second-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) too, USD 1.38M against USD 1.27M for Flávio Bolsonaro's, which pays 76.50% there.
fracos: 📺 Was left out of the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct under the legal criterion of congressional representation (Folha de S.Paulo).
In Vox Brasil and Gerp of 29/Sep he trails Ronaldo Caiado and Augusto Cury, with 2.7% and 3%.
Against Lula in the AtlasIntel [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he has 28.9%.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos rose 8.50pp raw in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), to 51.50% (vol USD 0.46M cumulative), at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, and 8.88pp normalized, and moved back ahead of Augusto Cury in that book, by 15.70pp. In the winner contract he is at 0.25%. 🏆 His contract in the winner book remains the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.68M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's. 🗳️ In the national polls of 29/Sep he is third in AtlasIntel, with 5.2%, and in Palver, with 8%, and trails in Vox Brasil and Gerp, with 2.7% and 3%. 📺 Was left out of the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 13.50% (vol USD 0.19M cumulative) in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), flat raw and up 0.17pp normalized, and Romeu Zema at 0.25%, at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT. candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT. The national polls of 29/Sep test Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema, and Vox Brasil and AtlasIntel put them against Lula in second-round pairings.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.79M cumulative. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 3rd PLACE contract he remains at 13.50%, in a USD 0.19M book. In the national polls of 29/Sep he ranges from 1% in Palver to 3.8% in Vox Brasil.
caiado.fortes: He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in Vox Brasil of 29/Sep, with 3.8%. In the second-round pairings he is Lula's closest opponent after Flávio Bolsonaro, 41.1% to 45.3% in Vox Brasil and 43.4% to 45.9% in AtlasIntel. 📺 He is one of the four invited to the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct.
caiado.fracos: Flat raw in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), while Renan Santos and Augusto Cury swapped positions ahead of him. Has 1.8% in AtlasIntel and 1% in Palver of 29/Sep.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, at the book's floor, with USD 7.71M cumulative. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and none of the national polls of 29/Sep tests him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no move to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by any of the six national polls of the day nor tested in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract has accumulated USD 7.55M, a larger volume than that of Augusto Cury, who is tested by the six houses and has USD 5.02M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.71M cumulative. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 3rd PLACE contract he falls to 0.25%. In the national polls of 29/Sep he ranges from 0.9% to 1.8%.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured. In Vox Brasil of 29/Sep he has 1.8%, his highest reading in the day's national polls.
zema.fracos: Remains at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, and falls to 0.25% in the third-place book. In Vox Brasil of 29/Sep he loses to Lula by 46.1% to 30.3% in the second-round pairing.

candidates.analise: Ronaldo Caiado stayed at 13.50% in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) (vol USD 0.19M cumulative), flat raw at the confirmed reading of 29/Sep, 11:35 BRT, and rises 0.17pp normalized, because that book's sum fell from 103.10 to 101.80, while Renan Santos moved back ahead of Augusto Cury. Ronaldo Caiado rose from 4.5% to 5.7% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of the Futura poll of 24/Sep and passed Augusto Cury.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep, Ronaldo Caiado has 9% in the Federal District and Romeu Zema 4% in Minas Gerais (G1).
fracos: Ronaldo Caiado stayed flat raw in the third-place book and has 1.8% in AtlasIntel and 1% in Palver of 29/Sep.
Romeu Zema falls to 0.25% in the third-place book and loses to Lula by 46.1% to 30.3% in the Vox Brasil second-round pairing.
Fernando Haddad is not tested by any of the national polls of 29/Sep in a presidential scenario and remains at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, with USD 7.71M cumulative.
